fusions.name: Royal Decree
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 8 tiles away for 32 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Call to Order
fusions.desc: Raises a wing to command quiet, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Flock Formation
fusions.desc: Allies within 5 tiles deal 15% more damage and gain 1 Power for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Regal Poise
fusions.desc: The moment your health is full, your damage rises 25% for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
